risks.risk: You may not be buying a PS4 console at all (photos show only a controller).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the actual PS4 console (front + back ports) next to the controller, with the console powered off and the model/label visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed/possibly not included (worst case: treat as controller-only until console is shown).

risks.risk: Hacked status and game count may be false or not transferable (e.g., account-based, not installed, or removed).
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing the PS4 home screen/library with the installed games visible (or disc labels) and system settings showing firmware/hack indicators if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/unknown hack + games not guaranteed (worst case: console only, no confirmed games).

risks.risk: Overheating/port issues may exist but aren’t visible in still photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short clip: plug in HDMI + power, show boot, then show ports working (USB device or charging) and a 10–15 minute gameplay/benchmark with no shutdown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have faults (worst case: assume not fully reliable).

risks.risk: Model (PS4 Fat/ Slim/ Pro) and storage size are unknown, which heavily affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/sticker (model number) and storage info (System Settings → Storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest matching category until model is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send photos of the actual PS4 console (front, back ports, and the label/sticker with model number).
Send a video of the PS4 booting to the home screen and showing the installed games list (or disc labels/cases).
Show a ports test (HDMI + USB + charging) and a short run test (10–15 minutes) to confirm no overheating/shutdown.
Show the UK receipt (photo of the receipt) and confirm what “original pads” includes (controller model(s) and quantity).
response.reason: The photos only show a controller on a box; the PS4 console, model, and the claimed 6 games/hacked status are not visible, so a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
